subject: (action) shinyapps.io:  refresh already deployed server.r ui.r files / LARGE cycle time

messages.author: 41c8dfe18058ef66
messages.subject: (action) shinyapps.io:  refresh already deployed server.r ui.r files / LARGE cycle time
parts:
Hi,

What is the best known method (BKM) for refreshing the server.r / ui.r files set after the application has been deployed using deployApp() from within RStudio on my windows 7 LT?  This seems like such an obvious functionality, but I have not located a BKM on shiny.rstudio.com nor within my local help file for library(shinyapps).

At this point, my BKM is deleting the app and deployApp() anew.  However, the cycle time for success re-deploying an appears to be about 0.7 hr.  This is a huge time hit!  

Thanks for your guidance and best regards.

Brendan

messages.author: 41c8dfe18058ef66
messages.subject: Re: (action) shinyapps.io:  refresh already deployed server.r ui.r files / LARGE cycle time
parts:
Hi,

The BKM for me is:
  1. Archive the application on shinyapps.io Dashboard.
  2. From the local working directory of your app, execute deployApp().  The method will ask permission to overwrite the application on your block at shinyapps.io.

Brendan
